title: Michael's fight with a sergeant at a missile site
place_text: Missile site, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I remember I got into a fight with the sergeant at one of the missile one of the missile sites.

plain: A former Air Force man named Michael Johnson remembers getting into a fight with a sergeant at one of the missile sites around Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota in 1977. He tells it himself, as one of the scattered memories from the time of the strange events he describes there.
